independent_review.scope: Formatted diagnostic instrumentation and deterministic regression premises only. No execution result, causal reproduction, repair acceptance or performance credit.

limitations: Counter and per-field observations are non-atomic; equal before/after counts do not exclude an in-progress clear or publication.
Only host state 2 attempts a snapshot; a busy registry can prevent per-request detail.
The diagnostic increments a counter on cleanup and must not be treated as an unchanged product performance binary.
